purpose: Add a Rust/Tauri native OS pipe execution layer that connects one producer process stdout to one consumer process stdin without a shell pipeline string.

artifacts.retention_policy: Retained as the close-out evaluation report for this implementation slice.
artifacts.cleanup_policy: No temporary file is created by direct pipe mode; report retention follows _history policy.
validation: Focused Rust test executes printf stdout into wc stdin through os_pipe.
Runtime contract and readiness tests require run_native_pipe_probe.
Package pipeline compiles the Tauri runtime.

resource_controls.cancellation_policy: Timeout path kills and waits for both producer and consumer process groups.
resource_controls.cleanup_policy: Parent Command builders are dropped after spawn so pipe file descriptors close; reader threads are joined before report return.
resource_controls.orphan_process_policy: configure_process_group plus kill_and_wait_child are used for producer and consumer cleanup.
resource_controls.backpressure_policy: producer stderr, consumer stdout, and consumer stderr are read concurrently into bounded buffers.

merge_strategy: The first implementation exposes a bounded probe command only. Downstream multi-CLI supervisor work must promote accepted stdout/stderr into task-run records or structured artifacts before affecting source changes.
plan_evidence: The user asked for stronger native tools for pipes and direct terminal control.
portable-pty already covers interactive terminal control; os_pipe fills direct process pipe graph execution.
The platform CLI pipeline workflow requires explicit process nodes and pipe edges instead of shell strings.
verification: cd agent-platform && PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m agent_platform.cli check-cli-pipeline ../_history/evaluations/2026/2026-06-06-native-pipe-runtime-tools-cli-pipeline.json
rollback_plan: Remove run_native_pipe_probe and NativePipeProbeRequest/Report from lib.rs.
Run cargo remove os_pipe from platform-desktop-app/src-tauri.

notes: Direct pipe mode does not create an intermediate file artifact.
This is a bounded probe/execution foundation, not the final multi-lane supervisor UI.
